messages:
alex: heads up — i'm starting the handoff in ~30m, i'll be primary until 08:00 PST. quick checklist below, please call out any missing perms or gaps.

alex: PD primary = me, PD secondary = tanya, backup = li. escalation policy: infra-high -> infra-pager -> oncall-sre.

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled handoff window for alex starts at 1779990001. PagerDuty rotation notice sent. :bell:

tanya: noted — i can cover escalation while you're on the early shift. verifying grafana and aws now.

li: i'm available as backup. if anyone needs temp access for tonight ping me and i'll spin up a session.

alex: runbooks: incident runbook (pg/generic) https://runbooks.redwood.example/incident-playbook and grafana dash list https://grafana.redwood.example/dashboards/ops. important dashboards: 'inference-latency', 'request-failure-rate', 'gpu-queue-depth'.

ops-runbooks-bot: FYI — latest playbook revision 3.2 includes the lazy-rollback step and canary commands.

jen-c: quick note — contractor jen-c reported cannot view grafana folder "oncall/ops" (403). she needs read access for observation only. who can approve?

alex: thx jen. jen-c shouldn't be on PD rotation, just needs grafana read. tanya — can you approve a read grant? if not, we can request a scoped temp role (no write).

tanya: i don't have org-level admin. i'd prefer to request JIT via idp. steps: 1) open idp ticket 2) request "grafana-read-oncall" role 3) set expiry 8h. someone from sec needs to approve.

alex: attaching quick commands for access verification:```
# check PD membership
pd users me:list --service inference-oncall
# assume aws role
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/OncallReadOnly --role-session-name oncall-session
```

li: i can't assume OncallReadOnly tonight until we add my account to that role's trust policy — i filed a request with infra-iam (INC-5941). ETA ~20m.

alex: noted. coverage gap: if li can't assume role by start time, fallback is: tanya handles PD escalations, alex handles AWS ops CLI actions (i'll have keys), li handles paging debug via logs only. mark this on the handoff.

oncall-bot: Incident channel auto-check: confirm that all primary & secondary have active PagerDuty sessions. alex: active, tanya: active, li: inactive.

alex: li — if infra-iam doesn't clear you in 20m call me and i'll hand you a short-lived sudo via jumpbox (only to be used for urgent mitigation). i'll log the grant and revoke after.

jen-c: sec approved the grafana-read request, but we need someone with admin to attach the role. who has admin rights tonight?

tanya: cc @alex — can you attach? i can chase sec approval.

alex: i don't have grafana org-admin either. ok plan B: i'll export the key dashboards (pdf) and drop into the handoff folder so jen-c can see. not ideal but works for tonight.

alex: final checklist before handoff: 1) confirm PD sessions (done) 2) li iam request status (INC-5941) 3) jen-c grafana view (sec approved, need admin) 4) runbook quicklinks pinned in thread 5) note coverage gap if li remains inactive.

li: INC-5941 updated — infra-iam says 'approved, deploying' ETA 12m.

alex: perfect. i'll start the formal handoff message in 25m with the bridge links and the incident-bridge channel. leaving this thread open — ping here if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
